name: employment-legal
description: Reviews hires and terminations for jurisdiction-specific risk flags, classifies workers against the controlling state test, tracks leave deadlines before they're missed, runs internal investigations, and drafts policies with state supplements where the law differs. Country-aware: works standalone (US behavior, unchanged) or alongside a countries/<code> plugin (e.g. countries/tr) for localized frameworks, citations, and connectors — see extension-points.yaml.
